**Job Summary**
Join Alight as a
**Web Technology Associate**
, where you will play a critical role in delivering a high-quality, customer-focused digital experience across our web platforms. This role is ideal for someone with strong attention to detail, a quality-assurance mindset, and a desire to continuously improve how web requests are executed.
  
  
In addition to handling day-to-day web updates using Alight’s content management system (CMS), you will help identify opportunities to improve content accuracy, consistency, and efficiency within established web processes. You will also help ensure the quality of web development, so all sites perform and behave as expected.
  
  
*This role is focused on hands-on web content execution and web development quality assurance and does not include ownership of digital intake, campaign management, or cross-platform operations.*
**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to common web requests, including:

+ Adding, updating, or removing content using the CMS
+ Investigation and resolution of reported site issues
+ SEO optimizations
+ Regional site translations

* Perform quality assurance (QA) on web pages to identify and resolve issues such as broken links, formatting errors, broken images, accessibility concerns, and content inconsistencies.
* Perform quality assurance (QA) on web development builds, identifying functionality that is not behaving as expected.
* Ensure all web content aligns with established brand, accessibility, usability, and governance standards.
* Validate updates across browsers and devices to ensure a consistent and reliable user experience.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver accurate, timely, customer-focused updates.
* Identify recurring issues or inefficiencies in web requests and QA processes and share observations with the team.
* Suggest small process improvements, documentation updates, or checklist enhancements to improve quality and turnaround time.
* Follow defined web operations and QA workflows while maintaining flexibility to support ad hoc requests.
* Escalate complex or technical issues to appropriate teams and track resolution as needed.
* Maintain documentation related to web updates, known issues, and standard operating procedures.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong attention to detail with a QA‑focused mindset.
* Customer-service-oriented approach with a proactive, solution-focused attitude.
* Familiarity with content management systems (CMS); experience with enterprise CMS tools preferred.
* Basic understanding of web concepts such as URLs, page structure, links, navigation, and page templates.
* Ability to recognize patterns, inconsistencies, or repeat issues and communicate improvement ideas clearly.
* Strong written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* Collaborative mindset with comfort working within defined processes.
* Knowledge of HTML/Javascript and server-side coding is an asset.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in web content management, digital operations, QA, or a related role preferred.
* Experience supporting internal or external customers in a service-oriented or ticket-based environment is a plus.

**Work Environment**

* Primarily office environment, computer-based work.
* Request-driven environment requiring organization, prioritization, and attention to detail.
* Opportunities to contribute ideas for improving workflows, quality checks, and documentation within the team.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you independently work through complex engineering tasks and apply strong software engineering fundamentals to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software. You contribute as a senior member of the team by partnering with engineers and product management throughout the software development life cycle, from design and estimation through testing, deployment, and support. In this role, you help improve team delivery by producing high quality code, strengthening engineering practices, and supporting secure, compliant software development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Write high quality, testable code that meets team commitments and the Definition of Done.
* Design, implement, unit test, and validate software solutions by following defined engineering processes and software development life cycle practices.
* Apply a test-first approach to software development where possible, and create automated unit, system, and acceptance tests to support quality and reliability.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and test plan reviews with other engineers to improve software quality, scalability, and maintainability.
* Support assigned integration, testing, and deployment activities to ensure successful delivery of software products and enhancements.
* Partner with product management to scope, estimate, and refine product enhancements and technical work.
* Troubleshoot and fix internal and customer-reported software defects by following defined processes and debugging best practices.
* Contribute to end of iteration demos, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts by identifying team impediments and helping resolve them.
* Write and maintain documentation covering program development, logic, code changes, testing, corrections, and related technical details.
* Participate in change management and on-call rotation responsibilities, including support for critical issues outside standard business hours in accordance with defined service expectations.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms; plus 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Advanced design, debugging, and coding skills.
* Ability to build secure applications and adhere to security standards.

title: Quality Improvement Engineer
description:
Anko Sourcing the exclusive direct sourcing arm of Kmart Group that operates the iconic retail brands Kmart Australia and Target Australia. Anko's operations span the largest sourcing markets across Asia including China, India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Cambodia, Indonesia and Vietnam, supporting an annual sourcing capability of US $ 3 billion.
  
  
With our strong commitment to sustainability and ethical sourcing, we provide a full suite of procurement services from sourcing, merchandising, packaging, quality assurance, quality control and international supply chain.
  
  
At Anko,, you will be part of a dynamic, growing business that delivers incredible results through a clearly defined purpose and strategy. You will work in an environment that is highly supportive, collaborative and encourages innovation whilst providing autonomy and challenge.
  
  
You will have access to flexible working hours, health and wellness programs, competitive remuneration and training opportunities with development plans to support your career growth. We offer an empowering culture with strongly embedded organisational values that define who we are and everything we do.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly proactive and technically strong
**Quality Improvement Engineer (QIE)**
to drive quality excellence across our supplier base. This is not a conventional Quality Control (QC) role focused primarily on inspections. The QIE will play a critical role in
**preventive quality management, risk mitigation, supplier capability development, and governance**
, ensuring sustainable improvements in quality performance.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive exposure to both
**Apparel and Soft Home products**
(70/30, 60/40 mix or similar), experience handling reputed international customers, and a strong understanding of diverse product categories, fabrics, manufacturing processes, and quality systems.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Different?**
Inspection activities are important but represent only
**40-50% of the role**
. We are seeking a quality professional who can proactively prevent issues rather than simply detect them.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**

* Drive Product Quality Management (PQM) initiatives.
* Conduct quality risk assessments before production starts.
* Analyze PPM (Parts Per Million) and defect trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Develop supplier capabilities and strengthen factory self-inspection systems.
* Conduct shadow audits, quality calibrations, and governance reviews.
* Drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Build a culture of quality ownership across supplier partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Preventive Quality Management**

* Drive proactive quality planning and risk mitigation across suppliers.
* Conduct risk assessments and identify quality vulnerabilities before production.
* Participate in Pre-Production Meetings (PPM) and review PP samples, GPT, Size Sets, and shipment samples.
* Develop and monitor Product Quality Management (PQM) initiatives.
* Analyze PPM and defect trend data to drive continuous improvement.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement robust CAPA programs.

**Supplier Capability Development**

* Build supplier capabilities for robust self-inspection systems.
* Coach and mentor factory quality teams on preventive quality practices.
* Lead quality calibration programs and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
* Conduct supplier assessments, shadow audits, and governance reviews.
* Support vendor capability enhancement and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Quality Assurance & Inspection**

* Conduct in-line, end-line, and final inspections as per AQL standards.
* Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with buyer requirements and quality parameters.
* Ensure effective implementation of buyer SOPs, quality manuals, specifications, and inspection protocols.
* Verify packing standards, labeling, assortments, barcodes, and carton quality.
* Collaborate with suppliers to reduce recurring defects and improve first-pass quality.
* Support shipment readiness and on-time delivery requirements.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage quality expectations for leading international brands and retailers.
* Work closely with Technical Development, Sourcing, Merchandising, RMT, Manufacturing, and Vendor teams.
* Present quality performance insights and improvement initiatives to management.
* Coordinate with vendors and factories to resolve quality concerns effectively.

**Candidate Profile**
**Essential Requirements**

* Strong experience in apparel manufacturing environments is mandatory.
* Proven experience in preventive quality management rather than inspection-focused quality control alone.
* Demonstrated success in quality risk assessment, supplier development, process improvement, and governance.
* Deep understanding of apparel manufacturing processes, garment construction, fabrics, trims, and finishing.
* Experience handling a broad portfolio of products across Apparel and Soft Home categories.
* Strong knowledge of Home Soft Textile products including bedding, curtains, cushions, throws, quilts, towels, and related categories.
* Ability to drive supplier ownership of quality through self-inspection and capability-building programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in trading companies, buying offices, or buying agencies will be a strong advantage.
* Experience handling reputed international customers, retailers, and quality standards.
* Exposure to multiple vendors, product categories, and fabric types.
* Experience working in fast-paced sourcing or buying office environments.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of fabric behavior, garment construction, trims, and finishing techniques.
* Proficiency in AQL standards, 4-Point Fabric Inspection System, and measurement audits.
* Understanding of product safety requirements and industry compliance standards.
* Knowledge of testing requirements including color fastness, shrinkage, performance testing, and product safety.
* Ability to review laboratory test reports and identify potential quality risks and non-conformities.
* Experience with supplier quality management and continuous improvement programs.
* Familiarity with social and environmental compliance standards such as BSCI, SEDEX, and ISO systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and reporting tools.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills to effectively engage buyers, vendors, factories, and internal stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
* High levels of integrity and professionalism in quality decision-making.
* Ability to challenge constructively and maintain quality standards while building positive supplier relationships.
* Effective time management and prioritization skills.

**What We Are Looking For**
The successful candidate should be able to clearly demonstrate:
  
  
Quality risk management achievements
  
  
Product Quality Management (PQM) expertise
  
  
Supplier capability development projects
  
  
Reduction in defect rates and measurable PPM improvements
  
  
Governance initiatives such as shadow audits, quality calibrations, and compliance programs
  
  
Successful implementation of preventive quality systems
  
  
Strong experience in apparel manufacturing environments
  
  
Exposure across both Apparel and Soft Home categories
  
  
Effective supplier engagement and continuous improvement leadershi
  
  
**Application Guidelines**
Interested candidates are requested to submit a
**concise yet detailed CV**
highlighting:
  
  

* Product categories handled.
* Apparel and Soft Home experience mix.
* Customer and brand exposure.
* Manufacturing experience.
* Buying office/trading company experience (if applicable).
* Quality improvement projects.
* Risk assessment and mitigation initiatives.
* Supplier development achievements.
* Audit, calibration, and governance experience.
* PPM reduction and measurable quality improvements.
* Key quality results and business impact delivered.

**Note:**
Inspection experience is important; however, it represents only a portion of this role. Strong evidence of preventive quality management, risk mitigation, supplier development, governance, and continuous improvement will be key selection criteria.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please share your updated CV with detailed achievements related to quality improvement, supplier capability development, risk mitigation, and governance initiatives. Candidates with demonstrated success in building quality into processes, rather than relying solely on inspection, will be given strong consideration.
  
  
**If you are passionate about building quality into processes rather than merely detecting defects, we would like to hear from you.**
Anko Sourcing values diversity and we pride ourselves on representing the diverse and multicultural communities of which we are a part. All information provided will be treated in strict confidence and used solely for recruitment purpose.

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
  
  
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
  
  
We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
* Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
* Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
* Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
* Stay current with state-of-the-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C++, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
* Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

title: Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**Role Scope**
Data Steward is an individual contributor role responsible for executing core data stewardship activities that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of enterprise data assets. The Data Steward manages end‑to‑end lineage monitoring, maintains high‑quality metadata, enforces policy and control compliance, and supports UAT for database changes and product distribution. Within the European Gas and Power Data team, the role supports the controlled transition of source data into internal databases and downstream delivery pipelines, ensuring raw data is validated, reconciled, transformed, and quality checked before it is made available to internal SMEs and external clients. The role performs detailed data validation, vendor data reviews, and works closely with Technology and Data Operations teams to resolve issues and maintain consistent data standards across systems.
  
  
Additionally, the Data Steward contributes to process improvement by driving standardization, enhancing documentation, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are looking for a process-orientated, methodological thinker with a keen eye for detail. Someone who enjoys dealing with large sets of data and problem solving.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Perform data validation checks, lineage tracking, and metadata updates to maintain data quality, integrity, and traceability.
* Execute data ingestion, validation, and integration activities in alignment with governance and control standards.
* Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise data policies and governance frameworks.
* Execute defined controls and compliance requirements to safeguard data integrity and lineage.
* Support vendor data reviews and onboarding through data quality assessments, validation checks, and issue resolution.
* Maintain data standardization, stewardship documentation, and process artifacts to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Execute medium‑complexity stewardship and validation tasks under established guidelines, escalating exceptions when required.
* Respond to client data queries, resolving issues and coordinating issue triage with Operations and Client Services teams.
* Collaborate with Technology teams on defect resolution, enhancement requests, and UAT for backend data and dataflow changes.
* Contribute to automation and AI‑enabled improvements that enhance efficiency and strengthen stewardship capabilities.
* Investigate, validate, troubleshoot, and support controlled updates to transformation scripts, data quality rules, and pipeline logic using Python, SQL and PySpark, ensuring automated processes continue to run to schedule producing accurate outputs.
* Support onboarding of new datasets required by SMEs by reviewing source structures, validating expected outputs, identifying data quality risks, and coordinating required pipeline or source data changes within the existing architecture.

**Process Excellence**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data, coordinating test execution, and assisting with defect identification and resolution.
* Ensure adherence to governance, data management standards, and operating procedures by following defined controls and compliance requirements.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation by updating process flows, data definitions, data dictionaries, and other stewardship artifacts to ensure audit readiness and operational clarity.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Data Operations and Technology teams to support governance activities, quality controls, source amendments, validation outcomes and issue remediation while serving as a key liaison between governance expectations and day‑to‑day execution
* Support Product and Technology teams by assisting with data requirements, validations, and operational coordination throughout change cycles.
* Assist with vendor data reviews by conducting data quality checks, performing validations, and coordinating onboarding processes.

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Data accuracy and integrity - Maintain high accuracy rates through consistent validation, timely corrections, and adherence to defined quality thresholds.
* SLA and turnaround adherence - Meet or exceed service‑level timelines for data updates, validations, issue resolution, and stakeholder responses.
* Documentation completeness and currency - Keep process documentation, data dictionaries, lineage records, and stewardship artifacts up‑to‑date, audit‑ready, and fully aligned with governance standards.
* Pipeline quality and delivery - Ensure transformation scripts, database workflows, quality checks, and scheduled processes run successfully, with failures investigated, validated, resolved, or coordinated through to closure in line with operational priorities.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**
**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate Python scripting skills, including the ability to investigate, maintain, debug, and support controlled updates to transformation logic, automation scripts, and data quality checks.
* Intermediate SQL capability to query, reconcile, transform, validate, and troubleshoot data across relational databases and pipeline outputs.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark or distributed data processing to support investigation, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and pipeline monitoring, would be advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows.
* Works with metadata management and lineage tools to maintain data transparency and trace end‑to‑end data flows.
* Possess foundational familiarity with BI tools and dashboards to review outputs and identify data anomalies.

**Functional Skills**

* Possesses solid domain and process understanding
* Understands data governance fundamentals, including data quality controls, stewardship roles, and ownership models.
* Supports data standardization by applying consistent data definitions, formats, and controlled processes.
* Has working knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and integration workflows, with the ability to investigate pipeline failures, check source-to-target accuracy, support root cause resolution, and coordinate remediation actions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data requirements/issues and generate innovative ideas and solutions.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data, documentation, and validation activities, functional teams cause analysis.
* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with cross functional teams including Technology, Operations, Product, and Vendor partners.
* Applies analytical mindset, critical thinking & creative problem solving to build solutions for business problems and while investigating data issues and remediation through root cause analysis.
* Demonstrates learning agility, digital acumen, initiative, and ownership in data stewardship activities, adapting to evolving tools and technologies while working effectively through ambiguity to investigate issues, and support timely delivery against operational priorities.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in data, analytics, operations, or related functions.

**Key Interfaces & Stakeholders**

* Partner with Data Operations and SMEs on data risk, quality checks, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate with Tech teams on data issues, enhancements, and UAT activities.
* Support Product teams with data requirements and validation.
* Ensure alignment with governance and compliance standards.

**What’s In It For**
**You?**
**Our Mission**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. title: MDM Technical Process Engineer (Business Partner)
description:
We're Hiring: MDM Technical Process Engineer – Business Partner

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Core Skills:**
SAP S/4HANA | SAP MDG | ABAP | Business Partner Master Data | Data Governance

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**MDM Technical Process Engineer – Business Partner**
to support Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, and data quality initiatives within an SAP S/4HANA environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), particularly Customer and Vendor Master Data (Business Partner), along with a solid technical understanding of ABAP, BADIs, enhancements, workflows, and system integrations.

In this role, you will help establish and maintain standardized data governance processes, improve master data quality, troubleshoot technical issues, and collaborate with business and technical teams to enhance data integrity and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

**Master Data Management & Governance**

* Define, implement, maintain, and continuously improve master data governance processes and standards.
* Configure and support SimpleMDG and SAP MDG for Customer and Vendor Master Data (Business Partner).
* Configure business rules, validation logic, derivation rules, approval workflows, and governance processes.
* Implement data governance policies, frameworks, and data quality standards within SAP S/4HANA.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve master data quality issues through root cause analysis and remediation.
* Develop data quality metrics, audit controls, and validation mechanisms using automated and AI-driven approaches where appropriate.
* Conduct compliance reviews and ensure adherence to established data governance policies.
* Assess downstream impacts of master data changes across connected business systems.

**SAP MDG Technical & ABAP Responsibilities**

* Analyze ABAP programs, user exits, BADIs, enhancement frameworks, and custom logic related to MDG processes.
* Support enhancements to validation, derivation, and workflow logic within SAP MDG.
* Collaborate with ABAP developers to troubleshoot technical issues and review custom developments.
* Analyze SAP tables, CDS views, data models, and related technical objects to support reporting and data validation.
* Debug and investigate MDG workflows, business rules, and integration issues affecting Business Partner master data.
* Perform impact analysis for system changes, upgrades, and SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives.
* Ensure technical enhancements align with master data governance standards and SAP best practices.

**Integration & Data Quality**

* Support the implementation and integration of MDM, data governance, and data quality platforms.
* Ensure reliable integration between the MDM platform and systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, and enterprise data platforms.
* Monitor integrations, investigate failures, and coordinate issue resolution with technical teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate data quality checks and strengthen data consistency across systems.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* **10+ years of experience**
  in data management, master data management, data governance, and/or data quality.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
* Experience configuring MDG data models, validation rules, workflows, approval processes, and governance frameworks.
* Practical experience with Customer and Vendor Master Data, including Business Partner concepts.
* Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including BADIs, user exits, enhancement frameworks, debugging, and custom code analysis.
* Strong understanding of SAP tables, data models, and CDS views.
* Experience with MDM platform integrations and cross-system data harmonization.
* Proven ability to perform root cause analysis, resolve data quality issues, and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience working with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams in an Agile environment.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* SAP MDG certification, such as MDG100, or equivalent training.
* Experience with SimpleMDG configuration and implementation.
* Exposure to Product Information Management (PIM), data catalog, data governance, and data quality platforms.
* Experience implementing MDM solutions across multiple organizations.
* Knowledge of Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry requirements, including product hierarchies, SKU management, and regulatory data requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate combines strong SAP MDG functional and technical knowledge with an understanding of master data governance principles. They can bridge business requirements and technical implementation, troubleshoot complex issues, collaborate effectively with development teams, and drive measurable improvements in master data quality.

**Interested?**

If your experience aligns with this opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply or share your profile to explore this role.

title: Integrated Logistics Customer Onboarding Solution Lead

* Ensure completeness and accuracy of system setup through validation and testing prior to go-live, minimizing error rates and reducing rework.

* Proven experience in ERP or TMS implementations.

* Detail-oriented mindset with a meticulous approach to documentation and process configuration.

title: Quality Control (QC) – Culling Expert
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
  
  
From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
  
  
We’re a fast-growing, passionate team backed over 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
  
  
Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.

Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.

This role focuses on
**quality, critique, and real-world photography workflows**
.
  
  
As a QC, you will review labelled data and AI outputs inside the Aftershoot app, evaluating them from a photographer’s perspective. You’ll help identify gaps between what photographers expect and what the product currently delivers.
  
  
If you’ve used multiple photography tools and enjoy giving thoughtful, structured feedback on image selections and product behaviour, this role is for you.

* Perform quality checks on labelled datasets and flag errors or inconsistencies

* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar-raiser round.

The team is responsible for performing quality analysis of the vouchers processed by the Accounts Payable team day before as well as check for the possible duplicate payments to stop the same from being paid to vendors again. * Extracting the population data on daily basis to form samples.

title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are rebuilding a large enterprise operations platform. The Product Analyst Intern will work closely with the Product Manager across documentation, requirement analysis and internal research through the specification and validation phase.

The work is mostly about understanding how a complex process works, writing it down clearly, and spotting where the existing documentation is incomplete or contradicts itself. Good fit for someone who reads carefully, writes cleanly and likes getting to the bottom of how something actually works.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Documentation**

• Draft and maintain product documentation — process flows, requirement breakdowns, configuration guides, release and change notes

• Convert workshop discussions and stakeholder inputs into structured written requirements

• Keep the document set current and version-controlled as decisions change

**Requirement analysis**

• Review business requirement documents for gaps, contradictions and outdated references; maintain an open-items register with proposed resolutions

• Map existing process rules and workflows and identify where they diverge from the documented standard

• Prepare test scenarios and validation checklists from existing specifications

**Internal research**

• Work with operations and client-facing teams to understand how the current process actually runs, and write up the findings

• Trace how specific cases and exceptions are handled today to surface undocumented behaviour
**Analysis**

• Work with operational datasets and configuration workbooks to reconcile inconsistencies and support requirement decisions with evidence

**Support to the Product Manager**

• Day-to-day BAU — meeting notes and action tracking, stakeholder follow-ups, status updates, query logs and quick turnaround asks

**Required skills**

• Strong written communication — able to explain a complex process simply and precisely

• Strong reading comprehension for long business documents

• Structured thinking and high attention to detail

• Working knowledge of Excel and comfort with documentation tools (Word, Confluence or similar) • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, business, economics, statistics or a related field

**Good to Have**

• Python (pandas) or SQL for basic data work

• Exposure to business process documentation, workflow tools or rule-based systems

• Familiarity with a high-volume operations or compliance environment

**What you will get**

• Direct exposure to how a large enterprise product is specified, validated and built

• Ownership of independent deliverables alongside hands-on support work

• Regular feedback and a portfolio of documentation and research work at the end

-

**Job Summary**
 Bechtel is seeking a Senior Quality Engineer for the Manufacturing and Technology team, based in Gurugram, to support the Pharmaceutical Project in Houston. The Senior Quality Engineer will monitor and verify project quality activities to ensure compliance with approved standards, specifications, project procedures, GMP expectations, and schedule requirements through audits, surveillances, and quality reviews. The role includes supporting GMP\- and CQV\-related verification of engineering and procurement deliverables, including quality requirements, supplier documentation, inspection and test requirements, traceability, data integrity, turnover records, and readiness for commissioning, qualification, and validation. The Senior Quality Engineer will identify quality conditions, CQV gaps, and opportunities for improvement within the Project scope of work, and will support the Quality Lead in implementing the Project Quality Plan, audit plan, supplier quality program, Closed Loop Corrective Action process, quality metrics, and lessons learned program.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Support the Quality Lead in implementing the project Quality Management System with specific focus on CQV readiness during the Engineering and Procurement phases for Lilly Houston Project work executed from the India offices. Facilitate development and execution of the project audit and surveillance program to verify that Engineering and Procurement deliverables support commissioning, qualification, validation, and applicable GMP requirements.
* Review material and service requisitions, quality requirements, supplier data requirements, inspection points, and data \& documentation requirements to confirm that GMP\-critical systems, Non\-Impact systems equipment, utilities, and materials are properly defined for intended use.

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

description:
**Location:**

 **Duration:**

**About Grade Capital** 




 Grade Capital is a long\-term investment platform for crypto portfolios. Our curated crypto baskets and mutual fund\-style portfolios are built on strict risk management, data\-driven research, and proven investment principles — designed for steady growth, not short\-term reactions.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 In fintech, a bug isn't cosmetic — it's someone's money. You won't be handed a script to click through. You'll learn to think adversarially about financial systems: where data drifts, what breaks under load, what happens when a price feed goes stale mid\-transaction.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





 • Write and execute test cases across web and mobile — functional, regression, edge cases.
 



 • Test real financial flows: portfolios, transactions, order execution, data accuracy.
 



 • Log clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, evidence, and expected vs. actual.
 



 • Validate APIs with Postman; verify response contracts and error handling.
 



 • Cross\-check data integrity across UI, backend, and database.
 



 • Work directly with engineers through the fix–verify–close loop.
 



 • AI\-First Engineering (Non\-Negotiable).
 



  





**Core Requirements** 




  





 • Strong analytical and logical reasoning — you ask "what if" by instinct.
 



 • Sharp attention to detail: the off\-by\-one, the misaligned decimal, the missing null check.
 



 • QA fundamentals — STLC, test case design, bug life cycle, severity vs. priority.
 



 • Basics of REST APIs, JSON, and SQL for data verification.
 



 • Clear written communication; comfort with Jira, Postman, DevTools, Git.
 



  





**Strong Differentiators** 




  





 • Automation exposure (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) or scripting in Java/JS/Python.
 



 • Interest in fintech, crypto, trading, or Web3\.
 



 • Personal projects, hackathons, open source, or bug bounty work.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***

title: CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The CQV Engineer will be responsible for the commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment, systems, and processes used in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. This role ensures that all systems operate as intended and comply with regulatory standards. The CQV Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Familiarity with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE).
* Develop and execute commissioning and qualification lifecycle protocols for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.
* Prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and as per regulatory requirements.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Review vendor documents (CTOP/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensure non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities
* Supervise vendors/ contractors on site during commissioning activities.
* Ensure compliance with current industry regulations and guidelines relating to Commissioning, qualification and validation.
* Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including protocols, reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM).
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 5\-8 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Experience with writing and executing commissioning, qualification, and validation of biopharmaceutical equipment and systems (e.g., bioreactors, chromatography systems, filtration systems)
* Experience in preparing Risk assessments for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* Strong understanding of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Familiar with Delta\-V and other PCS/ DCS systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Quality Control Engineer (Mechanical)
company: SVS Life Safety (a div of SVS Buildwel P Ltd)
description:
**Job title:** 
 QC Engineer — Fire Suppression Manufacturing \& Gas Cylinder Filling
 



**Company:** 
 SVS Buildwel Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Neetaji Subhash vihar Indl Area, Tikri, Delhi · On\-site
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time · Mid\-Senior level
 



**Job function:** 
 Quality Assurance · Manufacturing
 



**Industry:** 
 Fire Protection / Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
 



**About SVS Buildwel** 




 SVS Buildwel has manufactured and installed fire safety and ELV systems for 18 years, serving government, PSU, metro, railway and hospital clients across India. Our Firetrex clean\-agent suppression systems are built in our own plant in Rohini, Delhi — not rebranded.
 



**The role** 




 We are creating a dedicated QC Engineer position at the plant.
 



 That matters more here than in most factories. A fire suppression system is only tested in a real emergency. A defect that escapes our gate is not discovered until the system is needed. You will be the last person between the shop floor and that moment.
 



 You will report to the DGM — Production, Planning \& QC.
 



**What you will do** 



* Incoming inspection of bought\-out material against specification, and collection of test certificates at receipt
* In\-process inspection at defined hold points on the line
* Final QC and functional testing on every unit before release
* Cylinder weighing, pressure testing and leak testing, with records maintained at serial level
* Own the calibration register for all gauges and instruments, and withdraw anything out of calibration
* Raise non\-conformance reports, drive disposition, and verify corrective action closes the root cause rather than the symptom
* Handle pre\-dispatch inspections by clients, consultants and third\-party inspectors — you will face them directly
* Maintain batch and serial traceability so any dispatched unit can be traced back to its material and its operator
* Feed quarterly warranty failure data back into production and design



**What you need** 



* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* 3–6 years in quality control in a manufacturing plant — pressure vessels, cylinders, valves, fire equipment, HVAC or comparable engineered products
* Hands\-on with pressure testing, leak testing, weighing and the associated record keeping
* Working knowledge of calibration control, and of raising and closing non\-conformance reports
* Able to read engineering drawings and a bill of materials, and inspect against a written specification rather than by eye
* Able to hold a rejection under commercial pressure. This is part of the job, not an edge case



**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to PESO requirements for gas cylinders and filling
* Experience facing client, consultant or third\-party pre\-dispatch inspection
* ISO 9001 quality system experience, including internal audit
* Exposure to clean agent systems — FK\-5\-1\-12, NOVEC, FM\-200 or similar



**Why this role** 




 You will not be inheriting someone else's quality system. There isn't one yet. You will define the hold points, build the records, set up calibration control, and decide what "passed" means at this plant — with direct access to the department head and no layer in between.
 



 If you have spent three or four years executing a QC plan somebody else wrote, this is the step where you write it.
 



**To apply:** 
 send your CV to dip@svslifesafety.com with "QC Engineer — Plant" in the subject line.

title: Product Quality Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* A grasp of testing fundamentals — test cases, severity, the defect lifecycle, what regression actually means
* Sharp analytical instincts and genuinely strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication (a bug report is writing)
* Real eagerness to learn automation, not just tolerance for it
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or B.Sc in CS/IT — freshers and final\-year students very welcome


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs and API testing
* Anything you've built and shipped yourself, however small


**You will work with**
* Captain: Neha
* Team Members: Vikas, Aditi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: Sr. QA Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
 A leading independent academic publishing company is seeking a Sr. QA Analyst to ensure the quality and reliability of its business systems. The ideal candidate will meticulously test and analyse our software applications to maintain the highest standards of performance and functionality.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Own test strategy for features and cross\-system initiatives, defining scope, approach, coverage, dependencies, and test requirements.
* Apply risk\-based testing to identify critical scenarios, regression scope, and integration risks, and determine what should be tested, deferred, or excluded based on requirements and business impact.
* Understand end\-to\-end system flows and integrations, including upstream/downstream impacts, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Define and review high\-level test scenarios for complex features and integrated products, ensuring coverage of key functional, negative, boundary, and business\-risk scenarios.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Engineers from the requirements stage to understand business and technical requirements, identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the lifecycle.
* Test complex features, integrations, and bug fixes using appropriate manual and technical testing techniques, including API and database testing, and investigate defects to identify root causes.
* Drive test automation by identifying suitable automation opportunities and independently developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts in collaboration with automation engineers.
* Assess test results and quality risks, provide input on release readiness, and proactively communicate issues that may impact quality, timelines, or business outcomes.
* Mentor and guide QA team members on requirements, test strategy, scenario design, integrations, and troubleshooting, and review their test coverage where needed.
* Represent the QA team in cross\-functional discussions, clearly communicating testing status, risks, dependencies, and priorities, while maintaining strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and other QA teams.
* Coordinate integration testing for integrated products, working across teams to manage dependencies, test data, environments, and testing timelines.
* Contribute to improving automation coverage, QA practices, and test processes, including CI/CD integration where applicable.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and QA process improvements, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies and team activities.
* Demonstrate ownership, curiosity, and sound judgment by proactively exploring system behaviour and business flows, raising risks early, and making informed testing decisions with minimal supervision.


**Technical Skills**
 Skills, Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Manual \& Regression Testing: Strong experience testing complex features and integrated systems, with a focus on regression coverage and system dependencies.
* Automation: Hands\-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, with an eagerness to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies. Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving automation coverage.
* Test Strategy \& Risk\-Based Testing: Ability to develop test strategies, define test scope, identify critical scenarios, and make risk\-based decisions on test coverage.
* Integration \& System Knowledge: Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business flows, system integrations, APIs, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Requirements \& Testability Analysis: Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis: Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems, using logs, data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.
* Test Management \& Defect Tracking: Experienced in test case/scenario design, execution, defect investigation, tracking, and resolution.
* API \& Database Testing: Hands\-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman/SoapUI) and SQL/database validation; basic understanding of performance testing.
* Agile: Experience working in Agile teams and actively participating in planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant ceremonies.
* QA Process Improvement: Contributes to QA standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* GenAI: Experience using GenAI tools to improve QA efficiency, test design, analysis, and productivity.


**Soft Skills**
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management: Works effectively with Product Owners, Engineers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and risks.
* Communication: Clearly communicates technical information, testing status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Confidently communicates QA perspectives, challenges assumptions constructively, and influences technical and business decisions based on quality, risk, and customer impact.
* Curiosity \& Continuous Learning: Proactively explores systems, integrations, business processes, and new technologies to deepen understanding and identify potential risks.
* Mentorship: Guides QA team members on requirements, test scenarios, integrations, testing approaches, and troubleshooting.
* Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making: Uses critical thinking, technical analysis, and risk assessment to identify issues and make sound testing decisions.
* Ownership \& Accountability: Dependable in delivering commitments, proactively raises risks and blockers, and follows through on responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and business needs.
* Team Representation: Represents the QA team effectively in cross\-functional discussions and ensures QA perspectives, risks, and priorities are clearly communicated.
* Professional Maturity: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to balance technical, business, and team priorities.


**Work Requirements**
* Availability: Willing and available to work UK business hours.

 At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.
   

  

 Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Our mission is building bridges to knowledge — supporting the development of ideas through the research process to scholarship that is certified, taught, and applied.
